sources.entry: Learn Git Branching: an interactive game

summary.title: Learn Git Branching
summary.one_liner: An interactive, visual, browser-based game-style tutorial that teaches Git commands through levels and a live commit-graph sandbox.
takeaways: Practice Git interactively in the browser through a sequence of levels with visual feedback.
Start with Introduction to Git Commits, or jump to later levels if you already know Git basics.
Levels cover topics such as detaching HEAD and cherry-picking commits.
Type 'show commands' in the built-in terminal to list the available commands.
A sandbox mode is available for free experimentation via a special link mentioned on the page.
summary.summary: Learn Git Branching is an interactive web tool that teaches Git through a series of levels in a terminal-style interface with a visual commit graph. The page lists its main sections: Git and Hg (Mercurial) tracks, a Main and Remote view, and levels such as Introduction to Git Commits, Detach yo' HEAD, and Cherry-pick Intro. It describes a beginner path starting from the first level and a more advanced path for users who already know Git basics. The page text does not give details on pricing or platform requirements beyond being a web tool.
